about: Hermanos Marquez Mexican Restaurant is at 1315 S College Ave in Bryan.
It's family-owned and was formerly known as Mi Pueblito, a go-to spot for locals who want their Tex-Mex fix.
Customers have given it 4.7 stars across 229 Google reviews.
